nodes.relation: H098 supplies the concrete formulas, rational primal matrices, rational dual slacks, exact alpha values, and executable bundle that H096 only conjectured to exist.
H099 instantiates H095 with the exact H098 seed and fixes the generator, clause count, labels, and theta value for every family member.
H100 adds a strictly decreasing local potential and explicitly forbids a global acceptance-bit channel, closing the two circularity attacks that defeated H001 and weakened H009.
H101 merges the separate width, theta-rank, and restriction-closure obligations into one generator whose residual is measured simultaneously after all permitted affine simplifications.
H102 replaces opaque boundary symbols by explicit charged original-variable supports and fixes the composition semantics that H019 omitted.
H103 replaces H070's arbitrary polynomial compiler by a fixed nonadaptive local graph transduction and inherits H098 as its first mandatory counterexample test.

design_rule: C013 descendants must arise from a recorded attack, terminal formulation failure, or exact witness found during attack.
